articles.title: Bank Rate Pressure Puts Barclays Lloyds And NatWest Shares In Focus
articles.summary: The Bank of England is preparing to lift the Bank Rate again, and that shift in the price of money could quietly reshape the outlook for UK domestic banks and lenders. Rate moves change what borrowers pay and what depositors earn, which can alter how these businesses make money and manage risk. This article unpacks that story and highlights 3 UK banking stocks that are closely tied to this rate decision.
